verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that a docs-site search exists. The changelog says automations can review reader "search queries", pages can carry `search-metadata` frontmatter for a search integration, and Ask Fern indexes the whole site for AI Q&A with citations. Nothing documents a built-in search engine or its behavior. Missing for 10: explicit out-of-the-box full-site search docs, typo tolerance, relevance ranking, speed/performance evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
